name: Peterson Company
old_description: Welcome to Peterson Company’s Steel Division – your trusted partner for exceptional steel solutions in Utah & Colorado! With a rich legacy of delivering top-quality steel products, we provide a comprehensive range of steel materials for construction, manufacturing, and more! Our commitment to precision, durability, and customer satisfaction sets us apart. From structural steel to custom fabrication, we’re here to meet your steel needs with excellence and expertise.
about:
Peterson Company operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, serving the Rocky Mountain region through two divisions: a steel division that fabricates structural and custom steel products, and an electrical division that acts as a manufacturers' representative for electrical equipment. The company describes its history as a "rich legacy" but does not publish a founding year or ownership details.

The steel division produces fabricated steel products including perforated sheet metal, steel panels, and custom structural components. The electrical division represents manufacturers of electrical equipment, providing specification and sales support. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

The company markets its steel products to construction and manufacturing customers in Utah and Colorado. Its electrical representation serves original equipment manufacturers and contractors in the region. No specific client names or industry certifications are listed.

Peterson Company states that its commitment to precision, durability, and customer satisfaction distinguishes it from competitors. The firm positions itself as a single source for both steel fabrication and electrical manufacturer representation in the Rocky Mountain area.
